title: Pilobol.us P3-05: isolated proof backend on a CMS proof branch (GitHub App connect, build off Papyrus main, release-gate checks)
description:
## Goal
Prove, on a NON-PRODUCTION branch with its own isolated backend, that the migrated repo builds and deploys on the CMS Amplify app from the published packages, and satisfy the release-gate items that need a real Amplify build, before anything production changes.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06, read-only AWS)
- CMS app d11eu9hbs2mipk: one branch (main), autoBuild on, repository AnthusAI/Papyrus. Jobs 12-15 failed (2026-09-11 to 10-04), jobs 16 and 17 succeeded on 2026-10-05 (Papyrus main d04b068, 12 min 39 s). A failed job leaves the previous deployment serving.
- Amplify branch deployments create their OWN backend (separate AppSync, tables, Cognito, S3), so a branch cms-proof cannot touch production data (ASSUMPTION about naming, standard Amplify Gen 2 behavior: stack amplify-<appId>-<branch>-branch-<hash>).
- The production backend is EMPTY today (all 39 DynamoDB tables scan-count 0; media bucket empty; Cognito user pool has 0 users); see the plan. Production secrets live at /amplify/d11eu9hbs2mipk/main-branch-<hash>/ (names: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, OPENAI_API_KEY, PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET). A new branch needs its own secrets.
- Release gates (epic PPY-1f1489, comments 81291d, 492185, 19753b, c91ed6): BRD exact brand id (live branch values of PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND and NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND equal pilobol-us today: verified by equality check, values not printed); PRV middleware runtime nodejs unproven on Amplify WEB_COMPUTE; the content-actions Lambda in package mode (pip install papyrus-newsroom==<pin>) unproven on Amplify; staging-auth-test.mjs vs a real backend only run in a sandbox (PR #127).
- The CMS brand renders no Pretext article pages (renderer markus: getSiteRenderer throws), so the PRT/bodyIr gate does not apply on this app; convert-bodies has nothing to convert (0 rows).

## Exact steps
1. Preconditions (read-only): re-run the counts (aws dynamodb scan --table-name Item-<apiid>-NONE --select COUNT, and PublishedItem) and save get-app and get-branch JSON (names only for env, no values) to scratch as the rollback record. Save the get-app iamServiceRoleArn and platform.
2. LIVE (Ryan yes): aws amplify update-branch --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name main --no-enable-auto-build (stops the old branch from building the new repo's main later).
3. Ryan yes (LIVE), ORDER MATTERS: execute the reviewed change set from the infra adoption ticket (updates stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us: generated app build spec, branch env PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=published and SITE_ENV=production, no PAT). Do it BEFORE the console connect below, because a later stack update that omits Repository could disconnect a console-connected repo (ASSUMPTION; the change set shows it). Autobuild is off (step 2), so nothing rebuilds and the running production deployment is unchanged (env is baked at build time by the spec's .env.production capture). Re-check get-app repository after.
4. Ryan (console): install the AWS Amplify GitHub App on AnthusAI/Pilobol.us (only this repo), then in app pilobol-us-cms connect the repository AnthusAI/Pilobol.us (Hosting, connect/change repository). Record after: aws amplify get-app shows repository AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, platform WEB_COMPUTE, iamServiceRoleArn unchanged. If the console cannot switch the repo of a PAT-connected app or changes the platform/role: fix per PPY-a91e9c notes (aws amplify update-app --platform WEB_COMPUTE) or use the replacement fallback in the plan section 4.2.
5. Push the scaffold branch to the repo as branch cms-proof WITH amplify.yml replaced by the generated CMS spec (npx papyrus-infra print-buildspec --site infra/site.json --app cms-production); this branch only.
6. LIVE (Ryan yes): aws amplify create-branch --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name cms-proof --stage EXPERIMENTAL --enable-auto-build --environment-variables <map>: PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=published, SITE_ENV=staging, PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG=current, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_*=false (4), PAPYRUS_DISABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH=1, PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX=papyrus-pilobol-us-proof (must differ from production), PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS=http://localhost:3001/,https://cms-proof.d11eu9hbs2mipk.amplifyapp.com/
7. Ryan (console, Secret management for branch cms-proof): set PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET and OPENAI_API_KEY (a throwaway random value for the JWT secret; any non-empty value for the OpenAI key if the proof does not call it). Never paste values in chat or tickets.
8. Watch the first job: aws amplify list-jobs --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name cms-proof; fix forward on the branch until SUCCEED. Capture the log lines proving: which build spec ran (repo amplify.yml on this branch), npm ci, ampx pipeline-deploy, python bundling of papyrus-content-actions with papyrus-newsroom==<pin>.
9. Verify on https://cms-proof.d11eu9hbs2mipk.amplifyapp.com: /newsroom loads in a browser with the Pilobolus theme (Ryan eyeballs); curl robots.txt shows Disallow and the page has noindex (SITE_ENV staging); /newsroom redirect and / behavior correct (PRV gate: pages, redirect and robots work, middleware runtime nodejs); unknown BRD id fails the build (separate throwaway branch not needed: do it in scratch locally).
10. aws appsync get-type --api-id <proof api id> --type-name Item --format SDL shows bodyMarkus, bodyIr, aliases, metadata; the mutations deriveMarkus, saveItemDraft, publishItem, unpublishItem, requestStagingBuild exist.
11. Record results in this ticket and the plan doc table.

## Acceptance checks
- Job SUCCEED on cms-proof; proof backend exists with the new schema; Lambda content-actions deployed.
- /newsroom 200, / redirect as designed, robots Disallow, noindex.
- Production untouched: describe the production data stack LastUpdatedTime unchanged (2026-10-05T13:54Z) and get-branch main activeJobId unchanged (17), counts still 0.

## Rollback
aws amplify delete-branch --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name cms-proof (Ryan yes: deletes the proof backend; contains only rehearsal data). To undo the repo switch: reconnect AnthusAI/Papyrus in the console (the PAT secret stays until the retirement ticket) and aws amplify update-branch --app-id d11eu9hbs2mipk --branch-name main --enable-auto-build.

## Risks
- Switching the repo of a PAT-connected, CDK-owned app in the console is UNVERIFIED (ASSUMPTION): only repo-less to repo was tested (PPY-a91e9c).
- Console may replace the service role or flip the platform (seen in the connect test).
- The proof Cognito domain prefix must be unique account-wide (a clash fails the build).
- The CMS main branch must not auto-build the new repo's main while the scaffold is not on main (step 2).

## Needs Ryan
Yes for steps 2, 3 and 6 (LIVE); the console moments: GitHub App install and connect (step 4) and the branch secrets (step 7); the browser check in step 9. SSO login.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
right_now_summary: The team is preparing an isolated Amplify proof branch with a GitHub App connection and release-gate checks.
